svg.aria-label: Cable routes: cab–tub gap, junction box, roof and tent harnesses
svg.text: Cable routes: cab–tub gap, junction box, roof and tent harnesses
Risers up the gap to the junction box (230 V and 12 V sides), on up the cab back to the platform's hollow rear end member; tent harnesses across the lid front.
Cable routes: cab–tub gap, junction box, roof and tent harnesses
Generated by tools/wiring/diagram.py from cad/fitout/wiring.py — cable IDs and lengths
match bom/cable-schedule-v0.14.csv. Measurements still [EST] until confirmed on the vehicle.
230 V work: licensed electrician only (AS/NZS 3000 · AS/NZS 3001.2). Not certified.
VIEW FORWARD — at the cab back (tent and lid shown dashed) · 1:9 on A3
SIDE — from the passenger side · 1:9 on A3
Junction box (JB): internal barrier; J1/J2 and the 230 V conduit (R22) on the outboard side, J3/J4 and the 12 V conduit (R23) inboard.
Roof cables pass straight through on the 12 V side (R24) and are not detachable.
Cab back (R25): 32 mm conduit on stick-on clamps up the C-pillar corner, over the roof edge under the platform, into the end member.
End member (R26): hollow 34 × 34 extrusion; grommets where cables enter (underside, outboard end) and leave (inner face at Starlink / PV1-2).
Tent (R27/R28): T1A (230 V) and T1D (12 V + PV) in separate spiral wraps, saddled under the tent base and down the lid front.
T2 crosses from the tent top to the base at the FRONT HINGE with a 150 mm service loop: the shell opens about that hinge.
